name: 43023 · Granville, OH
findings: ZIP 43023 (Granville) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43023 (Granville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43023 (Granville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
